events.factual_description: The Atlantis and I.M.P. list SLIFT with Rhododendron for Thursday, October 8, 2026 at The Atlantis, 2047 9th St NW in Washington, DC. I.M.P. identifies 6:30 PM specifically as the door time, so no performance start time is inferred into showtimes. Ticketmaster is the authorized ticket destination linked by The Atlantis and displays the same date, venue and 6:30 PM event listing, but its accessible page does not expose a stable face-value price. Sub Pop lists Washington as the October 8 stop in SLIFT's October 6-24 North American tour supporting Fantasia. The label describes Fantasia as the trio's leanest and most direct record, contrasting it with the band's earlier long-form improvisational approach; Sub Pop also notes that 2026 marks a decade for Jean Fossat, Rémi Fossat and Canek Flores as this trio, and that most Fantasia tracks were recorded in a single take.

en.why_it_matters: The hook is not simply that SLIFT plays heavy psychedelic rock. Fantasia compresses a band known for long, exploratory pieces into a tighter and more direct form without losing the trio's physical guitar-bass-drums identity. Hearing that revised language in The Atlantis gives the DMV a compact local window into where the band has moved after a decade together.
en.trip_verdict: If this heavy/progressive thread fits your Thursday, take the local date at The Atlantis rather than chasing the New York stop the night before. The tour offers plenty of other chances elsewhere, so the value here is having this version of SLIFT in a small Washington room.

es.why_it_matters: La razón no es simplemente que SLIFT toque rock psicodélico pesado. Fantasia comprime a una banda acostumbrada a piezas largas y exploratorias en una forma más cerrada y directa sin perder la identidad física del trío de guitarra, bajo y batería. Escuchar ese lenguaje renovado en The Atlantis le da al DMV una ventana pequeña y muy concreta a dónde llegó la banda después de una década junta.
es.trip_verdict: Si este hilo pesado y progresivo te cuadra ese jueves, aprovecharía la fecha local en The Atlantis en vez de perseguir la parada de Nueva York la noche anterior. La gira ofrece otras oportunidades, así que el valor aquí está precisamente en tener esta versión de SLIFT en una sala pequeña de Washington.
